sub_sector.value: personal and commercial property and casualty insurance via independent agents

financial_business_type.detail: Writes auto, home and small-to-mid-sized business insurance, including professional liability, through independent agents.

revenue_driver.detail: Earns premiums on auto, home and commercial policies; also investment income on invested premiums.

customer_type.detail: Individuals insuring autos and homes; small and mid-sized businesses across many industries.

balance_sheet_dependence.detail: Underwrites and retains insurance risk and pays claims through its own insurance carrier subsidiaries.
